evidence: Disassembled all three readers. (1) engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel6EventHandler state 2 (lhz 0x5296d0, beq 0x529704): value 0 -> third-event shift r31 = 0; nonzero -> shift = main on-time as an angle (main_injection_pulse_width x cam_sync_position_high_byte x 256 / crank_period_accumulator), added to the auxiliary start angle 0x40b87d. (2) cm848_calculateAuxiliaryInjectionPulseWidth (lhz 0x475e0): value 0 requires (interval - main_injection_pulse_width) >= main_to_auxiliary_injection_minimum_interval, nonzero tests the interval itself, i.e. nonzero = the auxiliary start is already measured from the END of the main pulse. (3) state 4 (lhz 0x529878, bne 0x5298ac): value 0 -> shift = main on-time angle, nonzero -> 0, the opposite of (1) and (2). State 4 belongs to the speed limp home sequence only: engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch calls engine_injectionAngle_schedule_crankValid (sets TPU mode 18 and state 4) when crank_position_valid_flag == 1, the channel 10 cylinder handler picks state 4 only while injection_tpu_timing_mode == 18, and with the flag 0 the sequence is states 1 -> 2 -> 8 using the state 2 code (schedule_crankInvalid, mode 2). e2m Aux_SOI_End_Of_Main_Adjust (0x01805C0E, 'adjust Aux SOI to be relative to Main EOI, 0 = SOI-SOI, 1 = EOI-SOI') sits at the matching offset (cal block 0x01805C00 = CM848 0x4090e8; its next word EOI_Aux_Separation_Limit 0x01805C10 = DAT_004090f8 is used in both states exactly as 'separation from the EOI limit'), so 1 = end-of-main referenced; normal running (state 2) and the gap check agree, the speed limp home path (state 4) has the inverted test. With the dump value 1 the third event is therefore placed relative to the main END in normal running and relative to the main START in speed limp home. Second limp-home quirk from the same disassembly: in the fresh-compute branch of state 4 the limit test and clip use the latched DAT_0040b87d (0x5298c8, 0x5298e8) while the event is written with the freshly computed angle (r24, 0x529924). Address is not EEPROM, so no _cal.

plate_comment: Computes how far the pilot (first) injection is advanced ahead of the main injection, in counts of 0.1171875 degree: the cold-start rpm x coolant map while cold_start_phase is CSP_ABOVE_RPM_TRIGGER / CSP_ABOVE_RPM_VIA_EVENTS / CSP_SETPOINT_UNDERRUN, otherwise the sum, highest, lowest or main-timing-winner choice (injection_timing_pilot_offset_combination_mode 0 / 1 / 2 / 3) of a 4-map blend and the coolant, intake temperature, barometric pressure and boost components (each an rpm x angle map x a Q12 factor / 4096) and the fuel pressure limp home term (injection_timing_pilot_offset_fuel_pressure_normal_value, or injection_timing_pilot_offset_fuel_pressure_limp_home_default while fuel_pressure_limp_home_active_flag is set). While the governor holds a target speed (governor_mode_code 11 or 4) the maps are read at that speed and the result is scaled by measured / target rpm (the e2m constant-time pilot-to-main interval); cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTiming adds it to main_injection_timing to get the pilot timing for TPU-A channel 5 slot 4 (was engine_injectionTiming_arbitration_calc).

plate_comment: TPU-A channel 6 interrupt: the injection scheduling state machine on injection_angle_sequence_state. State 1 runs the cut-out, quantity and timing demand (engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand) and loads the pilot, main and auxiliary start angles (engine_injectionAngle_computeLoadCh6, which re-arms the channel for the scheduling angle and sets state 2); state 2 computes the pilot, main and auxiliary on-times and writes the three events (start angle, on-time, slots 4 / 8 / 12) into TPU-A channel 5 parameter RAM via engine_injectionAngle_writeTpuEvent, then state 8; state 4 is the speed limp home sequence (TPU mode 18, set by the schedule_crankValid scheduler): it does the same in one step, recomputing everything or reusing the angles of a still pending state 2. The auxiliary start is shifted by the main on-time as an angle (clipped to injection_end_limit_angle - auxiliary_injection_end_limit_separation) when injection_timing_auxiliary_relative_to_main_end_flag is nonzero in state 2 but when it is 0 in state 4. Was missing from every build (wrongly in deleted_functions.csv) | review-function-readability reviewed 2026-11-11 - Readability Medium Accuracy Confidence Medium | reached via tpu_a_channel_interrupt_handler_table[6] - mpc555_tpuAInterruptDispatcher 0x55de4 calls table[channel] - no direct caller
evidence: Plate refreshed from the disassembly of all three states (see the 0x4090f6 row for the polarity test and the state 4 condition). Event writes go to TPU-A channel 5 parameter words 0x304154 / 0x304158 / 0x30415c (angle) with the on-time in the paired word, slots 4 / 8 / 12 = pilot / main / auxiliary; angles are timing counts x -5 = 0.0234375 degree per TPU count (0x7800 = 30720 counts = 720 degrees). Old plate facts (missing-from-build note, review marker, dispatcher address) carried over.

plate_comment: Auxiliary (third, after-main) injection on-time, stored in auxiliary_injection_pulse_width (TPU-A channel 5 slot 12): looked up from auxiliary_injection_quantity (plus the main-pulse interaction correction while the main pulse is on) and rail pressure in auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_grid, set to 0 below the minimum on-time and capped at auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_maximum. The pulse is disabled when param_1 is nonzero (its start would pass injection_end_limit_angle - auxiliary_injection_end_limit_separation) or when the gap after the main pulse is shorter than main_to_auxiliary_injection_minimum_interval ticks (1500); that gap is the main-to-auxiliary interval itself when injection_timing_auxiliary_relative_to_main_end_flag is nonzero and the interval minus main_injection_pulse_width when it is 0. When the pulse stays off, auxiliary_injection_quantity is added back to the main quantity and the main on-time is recomputed (was cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming).
evidence: Name kept; plate refreshed with the polarity of the former injection_timing_timing_mode_cal read at 0x475e0 and the end-of-injection limit.

engine_injectionAngle_tpuUpdate builds it as lookup(engine_rpm_measured, injection_timing_cam_angle_correction_base_axis / _values) + ((cal 0x409098 x fuel_pressure_sensor >> 6) + cal 0x40909c) x engine_rpm_measured >> 22, plus cal 0x40909a when crank_position_valid_flag != 0 (speed limp home); the channel 6 handler then forces the auxiliary pulse off when (it - DAT_004090f8) < auxiliary start + shift. That is e2m EOI_Limit ('distance after cylinder TDC where EOI is forced', 0.0234375 deg per count) with EOI_Pressure_Scale_Factor / EOI_Limp_Home_Adjustment ('addition to eoi limit when running off backup speed sensor') / EOI_Valve_Delay_Bias (0x01819F00..04 = 0x409098..9c) and EOI_Aux_Separation_Limit (0x01805C10 = 0x4090f8). Not a cam angle correction.

Only reader cm848_calculateAuxiliaryInjectionQuantityLimit: nonzero replaces the computed limit with the next cal word (source code 7). e2m cal block 0x0180C300 = 0x409086: Aux_Quantity_Override_Switch ('1 = use override value'), Override_Value, Logic_Select (0x40908a, already named), Ratio_Limit (0x40908c), Aux_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch (0x40908e). No crank sync threshold; ROM address, no _cal.
The replacement value used when injection_quantity_auxiliary_override_switch is set (e2m Aux_Quantity_Override_Value, MM3S).

Code: auxiliary quantity limit forced to 0 (source code 14) when crank_position_valid_flag != 0 (speed limp home) and this word == 1. e2m Aux_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch: '1 = aux off during speed limp home; 0 = aux on during speed limp home' (0 in the dump). Not an engine sync force reset.

Dword read only in cm848_calculatePilotInjectionQuantity as the Q16 step by which the slewed accumulator falls toward the arbitrated target. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Max_Decrement (0x01805F04 = 0x409e4e, dword, 'decreasing slew rate limit for pilot quant'). Not a timing limit.
Increasing counterpart (e2m Pilot_Quantity_Max_Increment, 0x01805F08 = 0x409e52, dword).

In cm848_calculatePilotInjectionQuantity this is the target the slew accumulator (injection_quantity_pilot_slewed_q16) is moved toward: the sum / highest / lowest of the pilot terms, replaced by the cold correction or cold-start override value in the cold-start paths. All 16 accesses are lwz / stw (dword) and the compares are signed (see the type note).

e2m Speed_Limp_Home (0x01819B48): 'indicates whether crank or cam signal is used for fueling'. Writers: cm848_exitSpeedLimpHome (0, TPU-A channel 0 PARAM0 bit set / channel 1 PARAM2 bit cleared) and cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome (1, the opposite, plus the debounced fault bit 335 = e2m Speed_Limp_Home_Error mask 8000). Readers behave as speed limp home: pilot and auxiliary quantity forced to 0 under their Speed_Limp_Home_Switch cals (e2m 'pilot off during speed limp home'), engine_injectionAngle_tpuUpdate adds EOI_Limp_Home_Adjustment ('addition to eoi limit when running off backup speed sensor'), engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand replaces the 1.0 scale-factor target by the DAT_00408f50 / 52 / 54 derate curve (e2m Speed_Limp_Derate family). 1 = running on the backup speed input, 0 = normal; the old 'valid' reads backwards.
Incremented only by cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome up to the cal maximum; e2m Speed_Limp_Home_Count: 'debounce count for Speed_Limp_Home_Error to be set'.

The maximum compared with speed_limp_home_debounce_counter in cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome (e2m Speed_Limp_Home_Count). 0x408fa8 is outside the EEPROM range 0x3fd482-0x3feec1, so the _cal suffix is dropped.

engine_rpm_measured must exceed it before the speed limp home error (fault bit 335) is set; e2m Speed_Limp_Home_RPM: 'RPM must be greater than this for Speed_Limp_Home_Error to be set'. Not an EEPROM address, no _cal.

text: e2m block layout used above, all checked at several offsets against the code (e2m address = CM848 address by block, not by value): RAM variables 0x0180CE00 = 0x40b830 (Aux_SOI chain), 0x01806C00 = 0x40b960 (Pilot_SOI chain; +0x2a Pilot_SOI_Input_Engine_Speed = injection_timing_rpm_axis 0x40b98a, +0x28 Pilot_SOI_Constant_Time_Flag = injection_timing_rpm_snap_active_flag 0x40b988), 0x01808600 = 0x40b90e (Main_SOI chain; +0x20 Main_Penultimate_SOI = injection_timing_demand 0x40b92e), 0x01806A00 = 0x40b938 (pilot quantity), 0x0180C400 = 0x40b814 (aux quantity); calibrations 0x0180CD00 = 0x409090, 0x0180C300 = 0x409086, 0x01806D00 = 0x409e6e, 0x01808500 = 0x409e40 (+0 Main_SOI_Selection_Switch = injection_delivery_mode, +2 Main_Cold_Advance_Select = injection_timing_main_combination_mode, +4 LSG_Extended_Idle_Main_SOI = injection_timing_main_governor_limit_minimum), 0x01805F00 = 0x409e4a, 0x01805C00 = 0x4090e8, 0x01819F00 = 0x409098, 0x01804C00 = 0x4090d0. The names injection_timing_rpm_axis, injection_timing_rpm_snap_active_flag and injection_timing_rpm_snap_tolerance (0x409e78 = Pilot_SOI_Constant_Time_RPM_Window) are right as mechanisms; Cummins calls the feature 'constant time pilot-to-main interval'.

Lead 'Table family injection_timing_offset_*' is already done: the tables are named injection_timing_pilot_offset_*_grid / _axis / _values in global_variables.csv (and the variables injection_timing_pilot_offset_*), so no rename is needed; injection_timing_offset_cal (0x3fd808) and the _boost1..4_cal / _floor_cal rows are a different, EEPROM-backed feature. Table rename candidates found here (arrays, so notes only): injection_timing_cam_angle_correction_base_axis / _values -> injection_end_limit_base_axis / _values (the EOI_Limit_X_Axis / _Y_Axis lookup in engine_injectionAngle_tpuUpdate); the auxiliary-pulse interaction tables WORD_ARRAY_0005fa1a / 5fa2c / 5fa3e (x = auxiliary_injection_quantity, y = rail pressure, grid = scale) and WORD_ARRAY_0005f8ac / 5f8e0 / 5f8ee (x = main_to_auxiliary_injection_interval, y = main_injection_pulse_width_before_minimum_check, grid = correction), applied as (scale x correction) >> 4 added to auxiliary_injection_quantity: by analogy with main_quantity_pilot_correction_* use injection_quantity_auxiliary_main_correction_scale_x_axis / _y_axis / _grid and injection_quantity_auxiliary_main_correction_x_axis / _y_axis / _grid.

Type notes (no change made here): 0x3fd108 (now injection_quantity_pilot_arbitrated_target) is typed word but all 16 accesses are lwz / stw and the compares are signed, so it should be i32 / dword (the .cpp shows it as _timing_limit_arbitrated_target with a leading underscore until retyped, and xref_addr.py finds no function for it by name for the same reason); 0x3fd104 and 0x3fd0c6 were already retyped. 0x4090d5 stays a word at an odd address.

Other names that look wrong, found while tracing and not renamed: governor_speed_error_b_filtered is compared with the e2m Pilot_Shutoff_Acceleration cal (RPM/SEC) in cm848_calculatePilotInjectionQuantity, so it is probably the filtered engine acceleration; engine_event_active_flag (0x40b7d8) sits at the e2m Speed_Sensor_Select offset (+2 after Speed_Limp_Home) and cm848_calculateAuxiliaryInjectionPulseWidth uses it to choose crank_tooth_period_raw or crank_period_accumulator, i.e. it probably selects the speed source; DAT_004090eb / DAT_004090ed / injection_timing_speed_breakpoint are e2m HPCR_TPU_Latency_Dynamic_Wakeup_Duration / HPCR_Regular_Dynamic_Wakeup_Duration / HPCR_TPU_Latency_Min_Engine_Speed (0.4 us, the rpm-proportional latency angle of the pilot maximum timing), polarity of the breakpoint unclear.

Already applied before this wave and re-verified here: cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTiming and the injection_quantity_auxiliary_* quantity chain (former injection_timing_factor_cyl6_* names). The auxiliary-timing override (injection_timing_auxiliary_override_switch) never reaches auxiliary_injection_timing in this build because the branch returns before the write, and main_to_auxiliary_injection_timing_distance has no reader, so the override is inert for the third event.

plate_comment: Speed limp home path of the injection scheduler: engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch calls it when engine_speed_limp_home_active_flag == 1 (engine position from TPU-A channel 1) and the channel 10 cylinder handler calls it while injection_tpu_timing_mode is 18. Sets mode 18, walks injection_angle_sequence_state (2 / 8 / 1 -> 4) and re-arms TPU-A channel 6 at the injection tooth (was engine_injectionAngle_schedule_crankValid, earlier cm848_protection_condition_eval_set1; does TPU injection timing, not protection).
evidence: engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch: 'if (crank_position_valid_flag == 1) { read TPU-A ch1 PARAM4; engine_injectionAngle_schedule_crankValid(); }'; engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel10CylinderEventHandler: 'if (injection_tpu_timing_mode == 0x12) { state = 4; schedule_crankValid }'. The flag is the speed limp home flag (see its row), so 'crankValid' is the limp-home path and the old name reads backwards.

plate_comment: Normal path of the injection scheduler (engine_speed_limp_home_active_flag == 0, engine position from TPU-A channel 0): sets injection_tpu_timing_mode to 2, computes the tooth and phase of the next injection sequence, loads TPU-A channel 6 and sets injection_angle_sequence_state to 1, so the channel 6 handler runs states 1 -> 2 -> 8 (was engine_injectionAngle_schedule_crankInvalid, earlier cm848_protection_condition_eval_set2; does TPU injection timing, not protection).
evidence: engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch calls it when crank_position_valid_flag == 0 (TPU-A ch0 PARAM4 position) and the channel 10 handler calls it whenever the TPU mode is not 18; the init cm848_sensor_diagnostic_flag_update also starts in state 1 / mode 2. Primary input = channel 0, the one cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome switches off.

text: Slot / state facts for firmware/CLAUDE.md: the pilot / main / auxiliary events are written by engine_injectionAngle_writeTpuEvent into TPU-A channel 5 parameter RAM (angle words 0x304154 / 0x304158 / 0x30415c = slots 4 / 8 / 12, on-time in the paired word), not by channel 6; the channel 6 interrupt handler is the scheduler (state 1 compute + arm, state 2 write, state 8 done; state 4 = the one-step speed limp home sequence). Normal running (crank_position_valid_flag 0) is TPU mode 2 with states 1 -> 2 -> 8 per cylinder event (schedule_crankInvalid); speed limp home (flag 1) is TPU mode 18 with state 4 (schedule_crankValid). Angle = timing counts x -5 = 0.0234375 degree per TPU count (30720 counts = 720 deg). Event order in crank angle: pilot (slot 4, main + offset) < main (slot 8) < auxiliary (slot 12, main - retard). e2m names the third event 'Aux' throughout (Aux_SOI, Aux_Quantity), so 'auxiliary' is Cummins' own word.

Consequence of the state 2 / state 4 asymmetry (0x4090f6 row): the dump value of injection_timing_auxiliary_relative_to_main_end_flag is 1, so in normal running (states 1 -> 2 -> 8) the third event is shifted by the main on-time and the minimum-gap test in cm848_calculateAuxiliaryInjectionPulseWidth (end-of-main gap) is consistent with it, while in speed limp home (state 4) the event is not shifted but the same gap test applies. Speed limp home is an abnormal state, so this probably never matters on the truck; whether it is a Cummins quirk or intended cannot be settled from the code.

Polarity fallout of the crank_position_valid_flag rename (-> engine_speed_limp_home_active_flag, 1 = backup speed input): other names built on the old reading are now backwards or misleading and were not touched: crank_pattern_valid_flag (check its meaning), engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch (name fine, plate says 'crank-position-valid path'), and the run-state handlers that test crank_position_valid_flag == 1 / == 0 (cm848_setEngineCrankState1, cm848_setEngineRunState1, cm848_engineRunState3Handler, cm848_engineRunState4Conditional, mpc555_updateEngineRunState, mpc555_updateEngineCrankState, cm848_protectionOverrideEvaluator, mpc555_updateSensorDiagnosticFlags). The 16 users of the flag keep working; only comments and plates that say 'valid' need a pass.

DAT_0005a48a (ROM word -171, i16, 4 reads, no row) is left without a name. Two uses agree: cm848_j1939HandlePgn65504ProprietaryB sends ((timing + K) x 120 >> 10) + 125 and, with the TDC-referenced auxiliary flag set, auxiliary timing = -(K + retard), i.e. K = -(the reference point in timing counts: 171 counts = 20.04 degrees) with timing counts larger = earlier. The third use contradicts that sign: in injection_delivery_mode 3 cm848_calculateMainInjectionTiming adds K to demand + injection_timing_offset_cal, which only fits if the offset cal is measured the other way round. Not settled, so no name (candidate if settled: injection_timing_top_dead_center_offset).

Struct torque_limit_arb_t_0040a2f6: field source_priority is used by cm848_calculateMainInjectionTiming (20 sites, writes of the winning code), cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTimingOffset (7 reads: mode 3 'same kind as the main timing winner'), cm848_updateEngineStatusFlags (packer) and cm848_initTimingFilterStates, so it is the main injection timing source code (the Final_Timing byte of combined_emissions_state). The other fields (source_active, limit_source, fuel_minimum, ~85 sites) were not checked; no struct_field rename proposed because the struct name would then disagree with its first field.
